name: Rasan Information Technology Company
note: Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul 8313, Main Market) after its June 2024 IPO (MENAbytes, 2024-06-22: public market debut on Tadawul on June 13, 2024; 30% of shares offered). Operates Tameeni (online insurance aggregator), AwalMazad and Treza (Rasan's own site). MENAbytes (2024-05-09, citing the company's IPO documents) reported Saudi venture-capital firm Impact46 (Tatheer Company Finance, a CMA-licensed private asset manager) as Rasan's single largest shareholder, its 18.65% stake diluting to 13.06% after the IPO. Impact46's own site lists 'Rasan's 918M SAR exit' among its achievements while its current team page says Impact46 executives sit on Rasan's board; Rasan's current major-shareholder breakdown was not found in an open source (Argaam's shareholder page requires login).
